title: Casio Men Digital Watch AMW-870A-2AVDF
description:
The classic analog-digital combination all dressed up in beautifully gradated hues.
Featuring a gorgeous dial that adds stylish color to your wrist, as well as 50-meter water resistance and 10-year battery life, these watches deliver both style and functionality.
features: Regular timekeeping: Analog: 2 hands (hour, minute (hands move every 20 seconds))
Digital: Hour, minute, second, am/pm, month, date, day
